definitions.last_projected: The modulus shadow after the last DRS step, before phase refinement.
definitions.best_projected: The modulus shadow with minimum raw Gram residual among steps 0 through drs_steps.
definitions.final: The Gram matrix at the L-BFGS returned phase vector, initialized at best_projected.
definitions.raw_gram_residual: Frobenius norm of G@G-(9/4)*G on the original 9-by-9 Gram scale.
